projectDescription: A responsive React marketing website for Energy Upgrade Solutions, focused on Victorian household and business energy upgrades, clear rebate information, and enquiry conversion.

services.name: Marketing website
services.description: Responsive public-facing website with service information, upgrade process, eligibility guidance, trust content, and contact calls to action.

questions.question: Which language should the marketing website use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is a strong default for a maintainable React website.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for maintainable React development.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Standard JavaScript with a simpler, untyped setup.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the website use?
questions.rationale: React was specified in the request.

questions.question: What should the public website include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Service and rebate information, eligibility call to action, enquiry/contact path, customer testimonials, and responsive accessibility-conscious design.
questions.answer: Service and rebate information, eligibility call to action, enquiry/contact path, customer testimonials, and responsive accessibility-conscious design.
questions.rationale: These features suit the requested business marketing site and the factual topics visible on the reference website.

questions.question: Which data stores does the project need?
questions.rationale: This scope is a static marketing website; no data persistence or backend was requested.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The site is static/client-side and does not persist application data.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Relational database for structured application data.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational database for structured application data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for uploads and media managed by the application.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: A public marketing site does not require user accounts.

options.label: No
options.description: Visitors can use the site without signing in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users need accounts to access application features.
